method: Opened the two individual production Canvas sheets and the global overview at their stored resolution; no image edit or new render.

Three arms and the shaker, tray, drink and other visible accessories remain legible and contained in both facing directions.
Both complete guards retain their proportions; no visible crop, ghost fragment or nonuniform stretching.

overviewObservations: All 24 static families are visible and distinguishable at overview scale.

Intentional portrait crops are distinct from the complete guards; this overview review does not substitute for the other 22 individual sheet reviews.
limitations: Review concerns readability and preservation of the accepted native compositions in the production renderer.
